meta.title: Contact Us — Support, Feedback & Content Corrections
meta.description: Get help with {appName}, share feedback or feature ideas, or report an error in the Qur'an, hadith or adhkar content. We read every message.

title: We would love to hear from you
intro: Questions, feedback, content corrections, or partnership inquiries — send a message and we will respond as soon as we can.

corrections.heading: Content corrections
corrections.body: Accuracy in Qur'an, hadith, and dua text is a trust we take seriously. Please include the surah/ayah or hadith reference when reporting an error.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.body: Your message is used only to respond to you. We do not sell contact data. See our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

response.heading: Response time
response.body: We aim to reply within a few business days. Support for {appName} is handled by a small team — thank you for your patience.
